description: Explainable stated-fit matcher (v0): for a company's sector, stage, check size and geography, rank candidate investors by an EXPLAINABLE CHECKLIST of five criteria (sector_match, stage_match, check_size_match, geo_match, active) plus relevant_portfolio_count — never a single opaque score. sector_match is true when the firm states the sector OR has observed portfolio companies in it; stage_match when it states the stage OR is on an observed round at that stage; check_size_match when its stated check range OR the range of disclosed round sizes it has been on contains check_usd (round sizes, not its own check). sector_basis / stage_basis / check_basis say which evidence decided (stated, observed, both). Accelerators (Y Combinator, Techstars, Antler, ...) are excluded unless include_accelerators is true. Each firm carries relevant_partner — the most senior investing person known there, with their published contact routes — or null when none is known. geo accepts any country spelling or ISO code (US, USA, United States) or a region (north_america, europe, asia_pacific, global); geo_match uses the firm's stated investment geography when it has one, else its HQ, and is null when there is no evidence either way. Sorted by criteria_met, then relevant_portfolio_count, then deals in the last 24 months, then sector focus (fewer declared sectors first), then name.

geo.description: Company country or region, e.g. "US", "United States", "north_america"

include_accelerators.description: Also rank accelerators (Y Combinator, Techstars, Antler, ...). Default false.
